summary: Every acceptance criterion has implementing work (V01 P4; V05 P3; V06-V08, V10, V12 P1-P2; V11 the test phase's push; V02-V04, V09 are owed after the operator's actions), so the plan owes no further phase. Sweep r1 has three RED KubeCoder rows at 30df8e2d: root lint, vscode-extension build and vscode-desktop build. Each fails only because this environment has no `python` or `frontend` tool container (`cexec: tool ... is not available`), and a phase cannot fix that. The same commands run in `modern-app` are green (ruff check and format, both package-extension.sh scripts). The KubeCoder driver ruling waives only tests, so the question for the operator is whether to extend it to KubeCoder's lint and build, with the modern-app runs as substitute, or to add those tool containers and re-sweep. Residue fixed and struck: the library gate comments' over-claim (P2, JenkinsPipelineUtils caf6b75, kc project test green).
